eps.d: First episode of the new animated series, with narration by Andrew Sachs. A young boy discovers he owns a pair of very special wellington boots.
William wishes himself tiny, so that he can find his mother's lost wedding ring.
William wishes for the strongest conker in the world so that he can win the school conker competition.
William wishes to be a pirate, and finds himself on board a real pirate ship.
William is told to tidy up his messy bedroom, so he wishes for some extra help from his toys.
Barksure chases a cat up a tree, so William calls on his special boots to help him rescue it.
William wishes he were a real knight, and suddenly finds himself rescuing a princess from a dragon.
William doesn't want to eat his spinach, so he wishes that the whole world was made of sweets.
William wishes he was at the seaside, and finds himself helping a sea captain rescue a whale stuck on a beach.
William reads about aliens and wishes he could visit outer space, and before long is flying off in a rocket.
William is bullied in the playground and wishes he was a real cowboy in the Wild West.
It's a hot day, so William wishes he were somewhere cold and ends up helping a penguin to find his parents.
It's Christmas Eve and William decides to wish for more presents. But his boots are on the wrong feet, and his wish starts to go wrong.
William and his friends pretend to be Robin Hood and his Merry Men.
William's dog Barksure sinks his toy pirate ship, so William calls on his old pirate friend for help.
William and his mother visit the circus, and meet a clown who has forgotten how to laugh.
With not enough room in the sandpit, William wishes for a big desert to play in.
William can't wait to hear the end of his bedtime story, and before long he is flying away on a magic carpet and meeting a genie.
William learns about dinosaurs, and wishes he had one as a pet… until he ends up with a rather rude and greedy T-Rex.
William decides that Woolly the sheep needs a companion.
William and his mum visit the zoo, which makes William wish he was in a real jungle.
William's mum can't find the front door key, so Sherlock William comes to the rescue. Can he solve the mystery?
William learns about ancient Rome, and wishes he was there. Soon he finds he is taking part in a real chariot race!
William and his cousin are planting beans in the garden, so William tells the story of the magic beans and the giant.
William is having a bad day and wishes he was King William, who can do what he likes and even has his own castle.
After William's mum reads him a ghost story, William wishes he could meet a real ghost.
